summary: Newman Airport (ZNE/YNWN) is a regional airport serving the mining town of Newman in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia. It primarily supports the iron ore industry, providing critical connectivity for fly-in fly-out (FIFO) workers traveling to local BHP and Fortescue mining operations. The airport handles regular commercial services connecting Newman with Perth and other Western Australian destinations.
faqs:
Q: What airlines fly from Newman Airport?
A: QantasLink and Virgin Australia operate regular services, primarily connecting Newman with Perth. Charter flights also serve the airport due to its proximity to major mining operations.

Q: How far is the airport from Newman town centre?
A: The airport is located approximately 10 kilometres south of the Newman town centre, with the drive typically taking around 10 minutes.

Q: Is there car hire available at Newman Airport?
A: Yes, several car rental companies have counters at the airport, though booking in advance is recommended given the remote location and limited fleet sizes.

Q: Does the airport operate 24 hours?
A: The airport's terminal operates during scheduled flight times only, though the runway handles emergency and charter flights at any time.
transport_tips: Car rental is the most practical option for getting to and from Newman Airport, as the remote location limits rideshare and taxi availability. Several rental agencies have on-site counters, but booking ahead is strongly advised due to limited vehicle supply. Shuttle services may be available with advance arrangement through local accommodation providers or mining companies.
local_tip: Given the extreme Pilbara heat (regularly above 40°C in summer), arrange airport pickup with air-conditioned transport in advance and keep a water bottle handy, as temperatures inside vehicles parked outside can soar quickly.
